import re
HEAD = re.compile(r"^SPID\s+Status\s+Login\s+HostName")
RULE = re.compile(r"^-{3,}(?:\s+-+)+\s*$")
ROW = re.compile(r"^(?P<spid>\d+)\s+(?P<status>\S+)\s+(?P<login>\S+)\s+(?P<hostname>\S+)\s+"
                 r"(?P<blkby>\S+)\s+(?P<dbname>\S+)\s+(?P<command>\S(?:.*?\S)?)\s+(?P<cputime>\d+)\s+"
                 r"(?P<diskio>\d+)\s+(?P<lastbatch>\d\d/\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d)"
                 r"(?:\s+(?P<programname>\S(?:.*?\S)?))?\s+(?P<spid2>\d+)\s+(?P<requestid>\d+)\s*$")
ORDER = ["spid", "status", "login", "hostname", "blkby", "dbname", "command", "cputime",
         "diskio", "lastbatch", "programname", "spid2", "requestid"]
NAMES = ["SPID", "Status", "Login", "HostName", "BlkBy", "DBName", "Command", "CPUTime",
         "DiskIO", "LastBatch", "ProgramName", "SPID2", "REQUESTID"]

def parse(lines):
    recs, used, skip = [], [], []
    names = list(NAMES)
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if HEAD.match(ln):
            # the printed column names; the second SPID becomes SPID2
            printed = ln.split()
            if len(printed) == len(NAMES):
                seen, names = set(), []
                for n in printed:
                    while n in seen:
                        n += "2"
                    seen.add(n)
                    names.append(n)
            used.append(j)
            continue
        if RULE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = ROW.match(ln)
        if m:
            g = m.groupdict()
            recs.append({names[i]: g[k] or "" for i, k in enumerate(ORDER)})
            used.append(j)
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "sessions", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": recs}],
            "skip": skip}
